items.title: Allan Jaffe Interview, 1969-04-16
items.q: And we took Charlie Hamilton instead of Joe Rovershow. Which sort of, I remember they, you know, they, they never said anything about who to bring, you know. And it was, had, you know, had I realized, you know, they wanted Joe, I think, you know, Joe would have made the trip instead.

ctx.x: No, he went away. He had a plane ticket so he flew away.

I can still get the bus if I can get a cab. Okay. If I can get a cab, I'll miss the plane too, of course. I should have left you at 12 o'clock. It's not 12 o'clock yet. I know, but I'd have to leave here at 12. So look, so you better cancel it right now before, while it's still time. I wonder if I can call in here to get a cab? Uh-huh. Well, uh, let's say I already asked you, I guess, about George's role and so on in the graphic of Preservation War. Do you, just talking about Preservation War in general, do you,…
